profiles.name: Manish
profiles.heroSubtext: I transform raw footage into compelling cinematic narratives. With over 2 years of experience in commercial, documentary, and creative video editing.
profiles.aboutBio1: I'm Manish, a freelance video editor based in Mumbai, working with brands, filmmakers, and content creators to bring stories to life. I started in broadcast television, cut my teeth on documentary series, and now work across commercial, narrative, and digital formats.
profiles.aboutBio2: My approach is simple: understand the story first, then find the edit. Good editing is invisible — you feel it before you see it. I work closely with clients from rough cut to final delivery, making sure every frame earns its place.

projects.title: Horizon — Launch Campaign
projects.description: Cinematic brand story emphasizing high-contrast cinematography and dynamic soundscapes.

projects.title: Eye of the City
projects.description: Deep-dive documentary capturing urban life, architecture, and untold human narratives.

projects.title: Gold Rush — Neon Atlas
projects.description: High-energy music visual with precision beat matching, neon grading, and seamless speed ramps.

projects.title: Nexum — 30s Brand Spot
projects.description: Tight 30-second commercial cut built for maximum audience hook and broadcast compliance.

projects.title: Waveform
projects.description: Subtle, atmospheric pacing exploring memory, sound, and stillness.

services.name: Video Editing
services.desc: Narrative-driven editing for brand films, documentaries, commercials, and social content. Pacing, rhythm, and storytelling that keeps viewers locked in.

services.name: Color Grading
services.desc: Cinematic color work that transforms raw footage into a mood. LUT creation, scene-to-scene matching, and full film-grade finishing for any deliverable format.

services.name: Motion Graphics
services.desc: Titles, transitions, animated lower-thirds, and motion design sequences that elevate production value without distracting from the story.

services.name: Sound Design
services.desc: Dialogue cleanup, SFX layering, music scoring and sync. Audio that completes the picture — invisible when it should be, powerful when it needs to hit.

services.name: Social Content
services.desc: Optimized Reels, TikToks, and YouTube edits. Platform-native formatting, subtitles, and retention-focused cuts designed to perform.

services.name: VFX & Compositing
services.desc: Green screen compositing, tracking, and light effects. From invisible corrections to dramatic visual moments — seamlessly integrated into the edit.

testimonials.quote: Manish transformed our raw footage into a brand film we're genuinely proud to show. The pacing, music choices, the color — everything just clicked. Delivered ahead of schedule, too.
testimonials.author: Shreya Rao

testimonials.quote: We've worked with several editors before, but the level of attention to story here was different. Manish really listened to what we were trying to say and found it in the footage.
testimonials.author: Kabir Thakur

testimonials.quote: Three rounds of revision and he nailed every note without complaint. Our YouTube channel went from 10K to 120K in six months. The thumbnails and edits just perform.
testimonials.author: Priya Joshi
